title: Why Running From Cops Is A Bad Idea!
description:
On December 3rd, 2022, at 9:39 pm, Edmond Police Department in Oklahoma, received a report of a heavily intoxicated male who had come to his wife’s grandmother’s apartment and had kicked in the door. After kicking the door in the male suspect attempted to drive his white Honda Civic into the apartment building, damaging the front of the white vehicle, before then driving away.

Multiple officers were looking for the white Honda Civic before chasing the vehicle and stopping the suspect. The suspect was arrested and later charged with Resisting Arrest, Eluding a Police Officer and Endangering Others (Felony), Transporting an Open Container of Intoxicating Beverage or Beer, DUI, Leaving the Scene of an Accident with Damaged Fixtures, Leaving the Scene of an Accident with an Unattended Vehicle and Assault and/or Battery with a Deadly Weapon.
